answer: The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The velvet holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
